name: Lim Wei Xiang
bio:
Lim Wei Xiang's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Initially trained as a mechanical engineer, he found himself drawn to the intricate challenges of vehicle fabrication after volunteering at a local racing team during his university days. The precision and problem-solving required resonated deeply, leading him to specialize in chassis and component construction. He possesses a meticulous approach, ensuring every weld and joint meets exacting standards. 

With over 15 years of experience, Lim has contributed to numerous racing teams, from Formula 4 to GT racing. His deep understanding of material science and fabrication techniques makes him a sought-after asset. While he thrives in a team environment, he also values independent work, often preferring to focus intensely on specific tasks to ensure perfection. His ambition extends beyond simply executing instructions; he constantly seeks opportunities to improve existing designs and streamline fabrication processes, making him a valuable asset to any team.

physical.description: Lim is of average height with a wiry build, reflecting years of hands-on work.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to an exact point before starting any task.
Insists on using only metric measurements, even when others use imperial.
Listens to classical music through noise-canceling headphones while working.
